listing.name: Vagrant Story (PlayStation) (rood-boi)
listing.summary: A playable but unfinished Vagrant Story implementation according to the project. Unimplemented paths stop explicitly, and a complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Build from source on Linux x86-64 or cross-build Windows x86-64 through Linux/WSL and MinGW. There are no GitHub releases; Linux ARM and macOS are unsupported. Supply your own USA disc. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
